name: San Francisco International Airport

customs.v: CBP clears general aviation arrivals generally 08:00-22:00 (wheels down), 7 days a week, planeside at the Signature FBO; request at least one calendar day before arrival; landing permission valid +/-30 minutes
customs.quote: generally available 7 days per week, 0800-2200 (wheels down)

handling.v: general aviation aircraft clear customs at the Signature FBO; there is no CBP office at the FBO

notes: Read only the CBP KSFO fact sheet (29 May 2024, KSFO-0524); it does not state the time zone on the 0800-2200 line, local Pacific time is the natural reading. Not opened: FAA Chart Supplement (CS_SW_20260903.pdf) and SFO special notices https://aeronav.faa.gov/afd/02OCT2025/sw_SFO_notices_02OCT2025.pdf, FAA airport diagram https://www.faa.gov/aero_docs/dtpp/2608/00375SANFRANCISCO.PDF, FAA NASR page. The airport's own site (flysfo.com / fly.sfo.gov) gave no readable page; search budget ran out before runway facts were found. IATA code left null: the official pages read show only the FAA identifier, not a stated IATA code.
